title: feat(studio): the object page saves with Cancel and Save in the top bar, live at once
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi96kzyjcbK53dPTb3U2Eb422)_
Part of #36511
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

This is the first of three PRs for the card. It covers the object page. Still to come:

- PR 2: flows, the enable switch, permissions, and the object page's hooks and an installed app's own actions.
- PR 3: field layout, the AI-draft notice with its 「放弃 AI 的改动」 button, and the card's closing line.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：在 Studio 的对象页（字段、校验规则、动作、设置）改完后，顶栏右侧原来「发布」的位置出现「取消」「保存」。点保存后改动立刻生效，不再每隔一秒半自动存草稿。「变更」「发布」只在有待发布草稿时出现。
- 为什么做：维护者裁定，人类改一项就确认一项、点保存直接生效。本单是「保存即生效」这一系列的第一步，先做对象页。
- 出错会怎样：保存被服务器拒绝时，改动留在页面上，并写明原因；同一次保存里成功的项会被列出来。删掉或改类型已生效的字段前会先问一句。出问题可以直接撤回本单，回到原来的自动存草稿。
- 要你做什么：无。两人同时改同一对象时后保存的人可能覆盖先生效的改动，这件事已交席位按决策卡流程处理。

## What changes

**Mechanism.** A new top-bar coordinator in `studioSaveBar.tsx` does the following:

- Editors register their buffers with `useStudioSaveEntry`.
- The surface draws Cancel and Save at the right of the top bar, where Publish was, and only while a registered buffer is dirty. They are the column's last actions; only the right-slot icon follows them, as it followed Publish.
- One Save sends every dirty buffer in order. A refused buffer does not stop the others.
- When something is refused, the toast names each refused item with its reason, then lists the items that were saved.
- If any buffer holds an edit it cannot send yet, Save refuses before anything is written.
- Save first waits out the editors' expression check of the last keystroke. That is `LINT_DEBOUNCE_MS`, now in its own module `celLintDebounce.ts` (which `CelPredicateField` imports), plus 50 ms. Without the wait, a formula or rule guard typed and saved at once could be sent before its check had judged it (the objectui#4306 rule).

**Save = draft + that item's publish.** `publishSavedItem` calls `MetadataClient.publish(type, name, { packageId })`, which is `POST /api/v1/meta/:type/:name/publish?package=` at the package the draft was written to. It is never the package batch.

If the publish is refused:
- The draft the Save wrote is discarded, unless a draft was already pending before the Save (a copilot's). A pending draft is kept: it now carries the page's edits too.
- The edits stay on the page, unsaved, and the reason is shown in the refusal strip.

**Editors moved to explicit save in this PR.** All of them are on the object page, as one buffer with one Save:

- Fields:
  - Add, from the Records grid's plus column and from the Form toolbar.
  - Edit in the field inspector.
  - Remove.
  - Column reorder. This is now a buffer edit, not a save of its own.
- Validation rules.
- The object's own actions.
- Settings.
- Field groups.
- An installed app's object: base-field patches and added `__c` fields. These are saved into its `.custom` pair as an `object_extension` and published there, so they take effect at once.

**Editors not changed here** (they keep their draft autosave):

- Hooks. The hooks buffer lives in `ObjectHooksPanel` and unmounts on a tab switch, so it has to be lifted into the pillar first.
- An installed app's own actions in the pair (`pairObjectActions`).
- List and form views, navigation, flows and permissions.

**Top bar.**
- Changes and Publish are drawn only while drafts are pending. The "No drafts pending publish" disabled state is gone, because nothing is drawn in its place.
- Publish refuses, with a toast, while the page holds edits Save has not sent: its re-read would drop them.
- The surface's comment saying there is no per-item publish is corrected.

**Confirmations.** Save asks before it sends a change that removes or retypes a published field (`objectSaveConfirm.ts`). The field-remove dialog at edit time stays, and its body now says the field leaves once the change is saved and live. Studio has no delete-object affordance (measured: none in the Data pillar or its item tools), so no dialog was added for that.

**Leaving.** Opening another object with unsaved edits asks through `confirmDropUnsavedWork`. The switch sends nothing. The unsaved-edit registry the console's leave prompt reads now includes the Save bar's dirty state.

**i18n** (`namespaces/studio`, en + zh):
- New keys: `engine.studio.save.{save,saving,cancel,title,cancelTitle,done,refused,refusedLine,savedLine,itemSeparator,held,publishFirst,confirmIrreversible,confirmRemoveField,confirmRetypeField}` and `engine.studio.held.lineExplicit`.
- `designer.field.removeConfirmBody` is reworded.
- Alternatives considered: `engine.studio.saveBar.*` and `engine.studio.commit.*`. The name `save` matches the button's word.

## Tests

New files, named for this card:
- `DataPillar.saveCancel-36511.test.tsx`. Covers:
  - Nothing is sent before Save. Save sends a PUT of the draft with `?package=`, then a POST to publish with `?package=`.
  - Cancel re-reads the object with no writes.
  - A refused publish discards the draft. A refusal strip appears, the edit is kept, and Save is still offered.
  - A held picklist blocks Save.
  - Removing a published field asks at Save. Declined, nothing is sent; accepted, PUT then publish.
- `studioSaveBar.partialSave-36511.test.tsx`. Covers ordering, a partial refusal naming the item and its reason, the saved list, a held buffer, and Cancel.
- `StudioDesignSurface.saveBar-36511.test.tsx`. Covers:
  - With no draft, the top bar has no Changes or Publish, and Cancel then Save are the last actions.
  - With a draft, the order is Changes, Publish, Cancel, Save, and Publish waits for Save.
- `__tests__/studioSaveHarness.tsx`. A harness so a pillar mounted alone gets the same coordinator and buttons.

**Retired, with the reason:**
- `DataPillar.savedAtDisplayLocale-10232.test.tsx` (3 tests). The "Saved HH:MM" hint they pinned is gone: there is no autosave left to time.
- `StudioDesignSurface.draftVersionConflict-11773`, the case where two editors each load and save once with no draft pending. A Save now publishes, so no draft is left for the second editor's `If-None-Match: *` to collide with. See Acceptance notes.
- `StudioDesignSurface.publishReadOnlyReason-12303`, the objectstack#31495 "nothing pending" block (3 tests). Replaced by one case: no Publish and no reason are drawn.
- `StudioDesignSurface.interfacePolish`, "no draft: disabled Publish with visible reason". Replaced by: no Publish at all.

**Rewritten to the new semantics.** Each flipped pin asserts nothing sent before Save, then the draft write and the item's publish after Save, or that Cancel or a declined question leaves the page as it was:

- DataPillar, Save-gate suites: `celGate`, `panelGate`, `panelHold-27629`, `heldIncomplete-11786`, `choiceWithoutOptions-11253`, `summaryHeld-27461`, `authorRefusal-11785`, `actionRefusal-26736`, `showMeFocus-26730`, `picklistServedOptions-10202`.
- DataPillar, other suites:
  - `hiddenSystemFields-11780`, `recordsTab-34794`, `addFieldPopover-12516`, `copilotDraftMarks-12725`.
  - `destructiveChange-34931`, `draftSavedNamed-28984` (the toast is now "Saved, live now: Task" under one sonner id), `draftUnreadable-29148`.
  - `authoredBuffer-29793`, `pairActions-30088` (only its writable control), `baseObjectExtension-28575` (its double now publishes the pair's extension).
  - `validationVerdictHold-27644` (its double's publish refuses the guard the door refuses), `railSwitchFlush-27511` (the switch asks and sends nothing; a saved edit leaves nothing to ask about).
- StudioDesignSurface suites: `autosaveInFlight-11204` (Data block: an edit taken during a Save is the next Save's), `autosaveSwitch-11232` (Data cases), `draftVersionConflict-11773` (the race over a pending draft is refused, with reload and overwrite), `customizePublish-28562`, `narrowHeader-12509`, `packageListErrorPosture`, `publishPosture-12517`.
- `DataPillar.internalFormRetired-36425`, added on main by #36543 while this branch was open, now presses Save before its two Add group saves. `DataPillar.formViewLayout-30057` was deleted on main by that PR, and its one Data-page edit went with it.
- 17 edited suites gained a module-top `import '@objectstack/lint'`, as `check:test-source-alias` asks of an edited file that reaches the linter.

## Acceptance notes

- **Concurrent editors over a published object** (seat ruling 7089589821 on #36511: accepted as a transitional window; the server guard is tracked on #36601, not awaited here). The draft-version guard pins drafts only. After a Save publishes, no draft is left, so the second editor's next Save asserts no draft and succeeds over the first editor's live change. The server serves no published-layer version a save could pin. When a draft was pending at open, the race is still refused with the conflict dialog; that case is pinned in `draftVersionConflict-11773`. Until #36601 lands, the second editor's Save overwrites the first editor's live change.
- **AI and a human on one item.** While the page holds unsaved edits, the refresh pulse is held, so a copilot draft written meanwhile is not shown over them. Save is pinned to the draft read: if the copilot wrote a draft in between, the conflict dialog offers reload or overwrite, so neither side is lost silently. If the publish is refused, a pending copilot draft is kept and carries the page's edits.
- **A rule guard refused by the publish.** The object publish locator does not place a `validations.N.condition` path, so the strip reads "Not published: the server refused this draft. Details say why." and the rule's reason is under Details. This is the locator's existing reach, not new here.
- **The served-verdict hold** (objectstack#27644) still holds a rule whose stored draft the door refused, when that draft was pending at open. A Save the publish refuses now shows the reason at once instead of leaving a draft whose re-read holds the next edit.
- **Removing a published field** asks twice: once in the remove dialog at edit time, and once at Save. The card names a confirmation for both removal and type changes. Folding them into one is a product call left to the card.
- **ADR sentences the new behaviour contradicts**, for objectstack#36086:
  - ADR-0027 M2, "explicit, batched publish".
  - ADR-0037, "Publish remains the single commit gate".
  - The surface comment "There is no per-item publish". This one is corrected in code.
- **Not measured.**
  - The single-item publish was not run against a live server in this run. The route `POST /api/v1/meta/:type/:name/publish` (`publishMetaItem`) and the existing caller `saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata` are cited.
  - The full-farm CI families were not run locally (local scope rule).

## Verification

Read first:
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studioSaveBar.tsx`. The coordinator's held and settle check, and `publishSavedItem`'s discard rule.
2. `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, the DataPillar `doSave` and `doSaveExt` hunk. Riskiest: the refused-publish restore of `objStoredRef` and `hasDraft`.
3. `DataPillar.saveCancel-36511.test.tsx`.

Two-minute check: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/DataPillar.saveCancel-36511.test.tsx`. Expected: 5 passed, including the case where nothing is sent before Save, then a PUT with `mode=draft&package=` followed by a POST to `/publish?package=`.
